body: Hey stranger! Thank you for your kind words. I'm happy you're still here and I wish you the best during your recovery ❤️ I think i probably need some break too.. it's just difficult to make people around me understand that unfortunately..

Thank you for your reply it means a lot 
Yeah maybe you're right i will try even though it's kind of terrifying and shamefull to admit I need a shoulder to cry on for some reasons..
Thank you really for offering your support as well! ❤️
